CustomField.description: Reassign Lead trigger is looking for the Lead R.T in this custom setting, and comparing to the lead record type on the lead record being modified. The trigger will search for List of R.T that match the lead R.T., and then try to match only the owner id records that match to those records with a matching R.T. If it finds, then Lead Assignment Rules will fire.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: You can give a single R.T. value, or add multiple R.T.'s with coma separated values.
CustomField.label: Lead RecordType Name
